description: Service-specific terms and conditions referenced by each service in the agreement. These are displayed inside FMOS and optionally appended to the agreement PDF. Client-facing language — clear, not legal jargon.

universal_terms.title: Terms That Apply to All Services
points: All work begins only after the setup fee is received and onboarding is complete.
Monthly invoices are raised on the 1st and due by the 5th of each month.
Payment overdue by 7 days: ad campaigns paused. Payment overdue by 30 days: website taken offline. Services resume the same day payment is confirmed.
FortuneMarq does not guarantee specific results (rankings, leads, sales) as outcomes depend on market conditions, competition, and client cooperation.
Client is responsible for providing accurate business information, logos, photos, and access credentials in a timely manner.
FortuneMarq will not be held responsible for delays caused by late asset delivery from the client.
Either party can exit the agreement with 30 days written notice. Monthly fees are pro-rated to the cancellation date.
All logins, accounts, and assets created for the client remain the client's property and will be handed over upon exit.
FortuneMarq will never post content that is false, misleading, or violates platform policies on the client's behalf.

WEBSITE.label: Website Building
terms: The website is built based on the brief form filled out during onboarding. Changes to scope after the build starts are treated as new work.
Client gets 2 rounds of revision after the first preview. Additional revisions are quoted separately.
Website goes live only after Jabeer's final review and client's written approval.
Domain and hosting are the client's own responsibility. FortuneMarq assists with setup but does not own or manage these on the client's behalf.
If the client has a monthly retainer with FortuneMarq, basic website updates (text, photos, offers) are included. Structural redesigns are quoted separately.
On exit, the website files and all credentials are handed over to the client.
WEBSITE.cancellationNote: One-time builds: no monthly retainer unless the client opts in for maintenance. Maintenance retainer exits on 30-day notice.

GMB.label: GMB Optimization
terms: Client must provide access to their Google Business Profile. If the profile is not verified, verification is the client's responsibility.
FortuneMarq will post 8 times per month on the profile — offers, updates, events, and promotions. Post topics are decided by FortuneMarq based on niche best practices.
Review responses will be drafted and posted by FortuneMarq in a professional tone. Jabeer will alert the client to any negative reviews before responding.
GMB results (ranking improvements, views, calls) are tracked and reported monthly. Results typically become visible in 30–60 days.
Client must not make changes to the GMB profile without informing FortuneMarq, as this can interfere with the optimization strategy.
On exit, GMB access will be removed from FortuneMarq's account and all posting activity stops.

SEO.label: SEO
terms: SEO results are long-term. Meaningful ranking improvements typically appear in 60–90 days. Significant organic growth in 4–6 months.
Client must provide website backend access, Google Search Console access, and Google Analytics access for the work to proceed.
On-page changes will be made directly to the website. FortuneMarq will communicate all significant changes before making them.
Monthly reports include keyword rank tracking, traffic data, and the actions taken that month.
FortuneMarq does not use black-hat SEO tactics (keyword stuffing, link farms, cloaking). All work follows Google's guidelines.
If the client makes independent changes to the website (new pages, URL changes, plugin updates), FortuneMarq must be informed as these can affect rankings.
On exit, all SEO work done remains on the website. Google Search Console and Analytics access will be removed.

GOOGLE_ADS.label: Google Ads Management
terms: Ad spend is the client's own budget, paid directly to Google. FortuneMarq charges a management fee only.
Minimum recommended ad spend: ₹5,000/month. Below this, campaign performance is limited.

If the client's monthly ad spend exceeds ₹15,000, an additional 5% of the total ad spend is added to the management fee for that month. Example: ₹20,000 ad spend → management fee = ₹2,500 + ₹1,000 (5% of ₹20,000) = ₹3,500 for that month. This will be reflected in the monthly invoice.
Campaigns go live within 5–7 working days of account access and budget confirmation.
FortuneMarq will not increase the client's daily budget without explicit written approval.
Weekly performance summaries and a detailed monthly report are provided for every active campaign.
If payment is overdue by 7 days, campaigns will be paused until payment is received. This may affect campaign learning and performance.
The Google Ads account is the client's property. On exit, FortuneMarq's access is removed. Campaign history remains in the account.
GOOGLE_ADS.cancellationNote: Monthly retainer. Exits on 30-day notice. Campaigns paused immediately on exit.

META_ADS.label: Meta Ads Management
terms: Ad spend is the client's own budget, paid directly to Meta (Facebook/Instagram). FortuneMarq charges a management fee only.
Minimum recommended ad spend: ₹5,000/month. Below this, campaign performance is limited.

If the client's monthly ad spend exceeds ₹15,000, an additional 5% of the total ad spend is added to the management fee for that month. Example: ₹20,000 ad spend → management fee = ₹2,500 + ₹1,000 (5% of ₹20,000) = ₹3,500 for that month. This will be reflected in the monthly invoice.
Client must provide Facebook Page admin access and Meta Business Manager access.
Campaigns go live within 5–7 working days of access and budget confirmation.
FortuneMarq will not increase the client's daily budget without explicit written approval.
Creative direction and ad copy are handled by FortuneMarq. Final approval for any ad showing the client's face or personal brand content rests with the client.
If payment is overdue by 7 days, campaigns will be paused until payment is received.
The Meta Ads account is the client's property. On exit, FortuneMarq's access is removed. Campaign history remains in the account.
META_ADS.cancellationNote: Monthly retainer. Exits on 30-day notice. Campaigns paused immediately on exit.

WHATSAPP_MARKETING.label: WhatsApp Marketing
terms: WhatsApp Business API requires a dedicated phone number that is not linked to a personal WhatsApp account.
All message templates must be approved by Meta before they can be sent. Approval typically takes 1–3 business days.
FortuneMarq will not send messages to contacts who have not opted in to receive communications from the client's business.
Monthly broadcast volume is limited to the client's approved contact list. Growing this list is the client's responsibility.
FortuneMarq handles content, scheduling, and delivery. The client is responsible for the accuracy of any offers or promotions in the messages.
On exit, all message templates and contact list exports will be handed over to the client.

AI_AUTOMATIONS.label: AI Automations
terms: Each automation project begins with a paid discovery session (₹0 — included in setup fee). The scope of the automation is locked at the end of the discovery session.
Changes to the automation scope after build begins are quoted separately.
The client is responsible for providing access to all third-party tools required for the automation (CRM, calendar, WhatsApp, etc.).
FortuneMarq's AI automations are built on third-party platforms (WhatsApp API, Google Workspace, Make, etc.). Service interruptions caused by these platforms are outside FortuneMarq's control.
Automations are tested before deployment. The client must participate in the testing phase within the agreed timeline.
Documentation for how to use and manage each automation is provided at handover.
On exit, all automation workflows are handed over in a documented format. Third-party platform access is transferred to the client.
AI_AUTOMATIONS.cancellationNote: Monthly maintenance retainer. Exits on 30-day notice.

exit_policy.title: Exiting the Agreement
points: Either party can exit with 30 days written notice via WhatsApp or email.
Monthly fees are pro-rated to the last day of active service.
All accounts, credentials, and assets created for the client are handed over within 7 working days of exit.
FortuneMarq removes its access to all client accounts within 3 working days of the final invoice being settled.
